already_set.changed_format: debounce path; ordinary format changes wait for EQ-set-done
already_set.no_video: clears format-set-done and EQ-set-done after stable no-detection
already_set.three_buffers: accept only when buf0 == buf1 == buf2

initial_detection.FHD_AHD_predicate: slopes >= 80 and ACC gain > 2010; otherwise normalized to CVI code
initial_detection.special_formats: F3/F4/F5 branches with additional 0x05/0x06 writes and 100 ms delay
initial_detection.state_effect: set format-done, keep raw code, seed all three debounce buffers

scan1_policy: capture raw tuple only; no temporary writes; report unresolved when context cannot distinguish
